name: tpl-precedence-3-nogoal
task: Do not take the key until you have moved the ball away from the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a restriction ('do not take the key until you have moved the ball'), so `has_door_key` is only restricted, never commanded. The hard `Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key)` correctly forbids taking the key before the blocker is moved; the empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid here.

texts: If the blocking ball is not yet moved away from the door, the agent must not take the key.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, blocker_moved) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key, u1) -> -10
